messages:
ada: kicking off nebula-v2 catalog enable now — canary schedule 1% -> 5% -> 20% over next 30m. change window +30m. tagging @deploy-bot to kick it off. who wants fallback ordering?

deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting canary job nebula-v2-canary-1715554321. initial traffic 1% to variant nebula-v2 (quant-8). will post perf heartbeats every 60s.

marco: recommend fallback ladder: 1) nebula-v2-quant-8 (canary) -> 2) nebula-v2-quant-4 (lower mem) -> 3) nebula-v1-stable (current prod)

selena: +1 but add quick degrade: if p95 latency increases > 120ms OR error rate delta > 0.5% over baseline for two consecutive 2-min windows, move traffic back to nebula-v1-stable and alert oncall.

praveen: also pin the model hash for the canary: `nebula-v2@sha256:3a7f...b9` so we don't accidentally swap variants during rollout. I can push the pin now.

ada: (typo) ada: praveen please push pin, and set deploybot to `fallback_priority = ["nebula-v2-quant-8","nebula-v2-quant-4","nebula-v1-stable"]`. Also set `graceful_degen=true` so KV-cache fallback is allowed.

mike: running quick preflight checks on infra and routing:
```
# preflight
curl -sS https://canary-checks.internal/nebula-v2/health || exit 1
kubectl get pods -l app=nebula-v2 -n inference -o wide
```
All green from my side.

deploy-bot: canary metrics (t+3m): p50=22ms, p95=98ms, errors=0.04% — within thresholds. next step auto-increase to 5% in 5m unless someone hits hold.

selena: holding on auto-increase for 5m — noticed a small uptick in tail for EU region (p99 slowly rising). I'm watching for 2 windows.

marco: noted. if EU p99 crosses 200ms we should lower EU-specific traffic and keep global ladder. we have regional split config ready: `region_weights: {eu:0.5, na:0.5}` for canary.

deploy-bot: :information_source: attempted traffic increase blocked by hold flag set by selena. canary remains at 1%.

ada: decision tree agreed:
- if global p95 > 120ms OR error delta > 0.5% for 15m -> rollback to nebula-v1-stable and pin that variant.
- if regional (single region) p99 > 200ms for 2 consecutive 2-min windows -> reduce region weight to 0 for nebula-v2 and keep global canary at previous step.
- if no regressions, proceed to 5% in 5m then 20% after stable 10m window.

praveen: pin pushed: `model_catalog.pin("nebula-v2", "sha256:3a7f...b9")` and set fallback_priority as asked.

mike: ack — I'll trigger the rollback playbook if deploy-bot posts the abort token or I see manual `rollback=true`. Who should I page oncall to if rollback happens?

ada: page `#oncall-inference` + escalate to selena and marco. I'll open a Zoom if we need postmortem. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary still running at 1%. next check in ~2m. logs: `/var/log/deploys/nebula-v2-canary-1715554321.log`

selena: continuing to monitor. thanks team.

mike: ack, staying by.
